briefing: Markets were roughly flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P500 -0.4%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on trigger. Rather than forcing capital into all open slots, we made one selective buy (VAC) that shows full institutional-grade momentum confirmation, and left existing positions untouched to let profit targets and stop-losses work automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means only acting on a stock signal when multiple indicators agree — for example RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and rising volume all at once. Relying on several signals together, rather than just one, reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指只有當多項技術指標同時發出一致訊號時才進場，例如 RSI 處於健康的上升區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價站上均線，並伴隨成交量放大。同時依賴多項指標而非單一訊號，能降低追高或誤判短暫波動的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a pause after recent moves rather than a shift in sentiment. Trading volume and volatility were unremarkable, consistent with a neutral, wait-and-see market. Individual stocks continued to show divergent momentum, with several names in semiconductors and travel showing strong technical setups despite the flat index-level action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤指數小幅回落，並無單一主導性消息面因素，市場走勢較似近期漲勢後的整理階段，而非情緒轉向。成交量與波動度均屬平淡，符合中性、觀望氣氛。儘管指數表現平淡，半導體與旅遊相關個股仍展現分歧但強勁的技術動能。

trades.reasoning: All four bullish signals align (RSI 62.3 in the healthy 55-70 zone, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) and it diversifies away from our tech-heavy holdings.
